evidence.rowLabel: Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders
evidence.paragraph: For the three months ended June 30, 2026, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $112.4 million, or $0.61 per diluted share, compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $102.6 million, or $0.56 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025.
